description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to detailed project activity reports within the OrangeHRM Time module, specifically overriding the screen for project report criteria display.

classes.name: DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options for detailed project activity reports in the OrangeHRM time tracking module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to display project report criteria and returns null.
